newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba keeps repo rate unchanged at 3.0 pct.
newsitem.headline: Buba keeps repo rate unchanged at 3.0 pct.

text.p: The Bundesbank said on Thursday it would keep its main money market rate, the repo rate, unchanged for another two weeks by setting its next two tenders for securities repurchase agreements at a fixed three percent rate.
The Bundesbank made the decision at its regular council meeting.
The council also left the discount and the Lombard rates unchanged at 2.50 percent and 4.50 percent respectively.
Analysts had expected no change in the Bundesbank's three key rates.
